english.title: Send electronic communication with flashing images with intent to harm an individual
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, sent a communication by electronic means that consisted of or included flashing images, and when it was sent, you believed that an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY INDIVIDUAL..), whom you knew or suspected to be an individual with epilepsy, would or might view the communication, and it was your intention that that individual would suffer harm as a result of viewing the flashing images
english.legislation: Contrary to section 183(1), (3) and (10) of the Online Safety Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) For the offence applicable to 'condition 1' see H101563 where the person sending a communication reasonably forsees that another individual with epilepsy would be among the persons who would view the communication and the communication is sent with the intention that such an individual will suffer harm as a result of viewing the flashing images.
(ii) See H101565 for the offence of showing another person flashing images by means of an electronic communications device.
(iii) Section 185 of the Online Safety Act 2023 provides extra-territorial application and jurisdiction for this offence.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Anfon cyfathrebiad electronig sy’n cynnwys delweddau fflachiol gyda’r bwriad o niweidio unigolyn
